review: The R02a tsfg-ast entry accepts exactly one .ts filename and builds a fixed Program without parsing options or configuration. It rejects extra Program SourceFiles before AST, diagnostic, and borrowed Checker queries; no Emit, subprocess, or JS engine is reachable. NoEmit is fixed and iovfs.From(os.DirFS(cwd)) has no WritableFS. Necessary printer and emitter packages remain compiled dependencies. The current fork adds tsc/cmd/tsfg-frontend/main.go for the separate R02b target. The R02a AST entry and iovfs/iofs.go bytes are unchanged from the previously reviewed fork; the new main is not linked into tsfg-ast. Renewed analysis applies to this exact fork and its runtime JS negatives must rerun.
